text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —The final day of summer training camp.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Huh? My dash time isn't coming out as well 
as I thought.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Bwahahaha! Doto, that's just because of... 
you know, the summer heat.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: I see. But what does that mean?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Bwahahaha, why don't you ask me about that 
when summer comes around!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Well, another run ought to clear that 
right up. Let us march forth, Doto!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Hai-ee, yes please! I have to do something 
about this. Somehow...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Impatience and shadow cross Meisho Doto's 
face... No matter how you look at it, her 
running lacks the sheer dread and 
dominance of T.M. Opera O...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A summer of agony and stagnation—with no 
end in sight.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just then, a familiar figure approached 
nearby.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
If I remember correctly... Doto's Trainer? 
...Hello.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her classmate, Admire Vega. If I recall, 
she was supposed to still be on break, 
but...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Somehow, just enough to be able to walk 
around.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...You look so serious. What happened?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After much thought... I confide my 
worries. About Air Shakur's hypothesis: 
the "numerical ceiling."

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
A ceiling... there was a story like 
that...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
I don't really understand complicated 
things... But still...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Looking at the two of them from where I 
stand, I might be able to see something 
different.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Having kept my distance for a while, 
I might notice things you miss when you're 
too close.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Let's observe for now.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I decided to secretly watch Meisho Doto 
and T.M. Opera O dash side by side.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Dadadada!)

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
What's wrong, Doto?! Come on, catch up 
with me!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Huff, puff, haah...! Please wait, Opera 
O-saaan!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...Nothing in particular. Though...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
"There is something that's been bothering 
me a bit. Those two... especially Doto..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Admire Vega is lost in thought. It seems 
she might have faintly sensed something, 
but...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Oooooh!? Could it be that person over 
there is...!? Doto, look!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Huh, Ayabe...-san? No... way...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Ayabe-saaaan, WAAAAAAAH!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Um... it's been a while.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Speculations buried within a circle of 
warm welcomes. And so, the bittersweet 
summer training camp came to an end.
